title: COSTAR predicts drug activity tested in glioblastoma samples
summary: A learned drug-target connectivity signature selected 23 predicted hits and 25 negatives for testing in four glioblastoma patient samples. Ex-vivo measurements agreed with predictions at a reported mean ROC AUC of 0.94. The small validation establishes a bounded drug-activity prediction result, not clinical response. Vortioxetine was found by the initial experimental screen and is not attributed to COSTAR nomination.
organization: ETH Zurich; University Hospital Zurich; University of Zurich

evidence.tested: Newly selected compounds were tested ex vivo across four patient samples.
evidence.unknown: Patient benefit, generalization and clinical safety remain unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: COSTAR logistic LASSO drug-target model supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.
